newsitem.title: USA: Digitran Systems files Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Digitran Systems files Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

text.p: Digitran Systems Inc filed for Chapter 11 protection late Friday in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware.
In court papers, the company, based in Logan, Utah, listed assets of $1.8 million and liabilities of $20.2 million.
A spokeswoman told Reuters the company was considering withdrawing the petition.
Digitran, which supplies training simulators for the petroleum industry, was delisted by the American Stock Exchange in March.
